# UC-382 — Handle a Return Auto-Approved After the 72-Hour Inspection Window

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-382
- **Title:** Handle a Return Auto-Approved After the 72-Hour Inspection Window
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner/Manager staff of the own store
- **Trigger:** The vendor opens a `RETURN_RECEIVED` return that was never inspected within 72 hours
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Understand and absorb the automatic approval so the refund path proceeds without a futile late inspection.
- **Preconditions:** Return at `RETURN_RECEIVED` (BR-RET-02); 72 h elapsed without an inspection (BR-RET-05); own-store scope (BR-VND-07).

## Main Scenario
1. Vendor opens the return → client `GET /store/returns/{id}` shows `inspection.autoApproved = true` and the refund status (API-RET-005).
2. The 72-hour inspection window closed with no record → System auto-approved the return (BR-RET-05, EC-38).
3. Return state settled to `REFUNDED`; the refund path proceeds — item value, shipping only for platform/vendor fault (BR-RET-02, BR-RET-03).
4. Vendor tries to inspect anyway → `POST /store/returns/{id}/inspection` returns `INSPECTION_WINDOW_PASSED`; nothing is written (API-RET-009).
5. Refund credits the customer wallet within 3 business days of `REFUNDED` (BR-RET-04); the vendor received a notification of the auto-approval (EC-38).
6. Commission reversal and escrow adjustment follow the refund (BR-RET-07, BR-ESC-04).

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Inspect before the deadline:** PASS → `REFUNDED` with pending refund; FAIL → `DISPUTED` for admin review (API-RET-009).
- **A2 — Late inspection blocked:** the endpoint refuses once auto-approval ran; the vendor reads the outcome instead (API-RET-009).
- **A3 — Refund later disputed:** an active dispute freezes escrow release for this sub-order (BR-ORD-05).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Concurrent inspection at the deadline:** one writer wins; the loser gets `STATE_CONFLICT` or `INSPECTION_WINDOW_PASSED` (API-RET-009, EC-14).
- **E2 — Notification not seen:** state and refund proceed regardless — no vendor action is required (BR-RET-05).
- **E3 — Foreign store's return:** → 404 `NOT_FOUND` (BR-VND-07).

## Postconditions
- Return is `REFUNDED` with `autoApproved` recorded; no vendor decision remains open (BR-RET-05).
- Refund pending wallet credit ≤3 business days; commission reversed proportionally on release adjustments (BR-RET-04, BR-RET-07).

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-RET-05, BR-RET-02, BR-RET-03, BR-RET-04, BR-RET-07, BR-VND-07

## Related Requirements
- FR-016 (Returns & Refunds)
- Cross-reference: UC-195 inspects within the window (the on-time path this UC is the counterpart of).

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** own-store read; the auto-approval itself runs as System — no interactive login.
- **Data involved:** return/inspection record (`autoApproved`), refund status, `order_status_history`, escrow hold.
- **External dependencies:** refund engine and wallet credit (B07); notification of auto-approval (B10); Admin queue if later disputed (B13).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC382-01:** Given a `RETURN_RECEIVED` return untouched for 72 h, when the window closes, then the return auto-approves and settles to `REFUNDED` (BR-RET-05).
- **AC-UC382-02:** Given the auto-approval, when the vendor submits an inspection, then `INSPECTION_WINDOW_PASSED` is returned and no inspection row is written (API-RET-009).
- **AC-UC382-03:** Given the `REFUNDED` state, when the refund executes, then the wallet credit lands within 3 business days (BR-RET-04).
- **AC-UC382-04:** Given an inspected-on-time return, when the deadline has not passed, then auto-approval does not run (BR-RET-05).
